_comment: This is the gate. The Lambda is the decision; this is the enforcement.
Attach to every principal that must not start runs directly -- humans,
CI roles, notebook roles. At organisation scale it belongs in an SCP so
that it cannot be detached by the account it constrains.
The condition is on the role that HealthOmics sees as the caller. A deny
without the ArnNotLike exception would also lock out the gate itself, and
a deny that names the gate by user rather than by role breaks the first
